items.title: Argenx inks $1.15B Unnatural Products buyout to expand in oral peptides
items.summary: Argenx has struck a deal to acquire Unnatural Products for $550 million upfront, snapping up the Merck & Co.- and Novartis-partnered biotech to add oral peptide capabilities.

items.title: AHA: Novartis’ Lp(a) drug shows zero benefit, casting shadow over Amgen and Lilly programs
items.summary: Novartis has lifted the lid on data from its failed cardiovascular outcomes trial, reporting a total absence of efficacy that could intensify questions about upcoming readouts from Amgen and Eli Lilly.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Novo's longtime CFO to hang up gloves as Galderma exec steps in
items.summary: Novo's CFO of the past 8 years is taking his leave at the end of the year. Alnylam is on the hunt for a new commercial chief amid news of Tolga Tanguler's departure. Amgen has looked within to replace its head of quality.

items.title: There's more than one way to build a biotech
items.summary: Axiom Biosciences is taking an unconventional approach to raising capital and developing new therapies. In this episode of "The Top Line," founder and CEO Remo Moomiaie-Qajar joins Fierce Biotech's Marissa Russo to discuss the company's financing strategy, drug development approach and upcoming clinical milestones.

items.title: Generate CEO sees ‘huge opportunity’ from using Claude to shorten CAR-T cell engines
items.summary: Generate Biomedicines' CEO has hailed the “huge opportunity” offered by AI tools after the Flagship-founded company used Anthropic's Claude AI platform to reduce the size of CAR-T cell engines.

items.title: Moderna’s norovirus vaccine plans in limbo in wake of phase 3 miss
items.summary: Moderna has scrapped plans to enroll a new cohort in a phase 3 trial of its norovirus vaccine and instead will meet with regulators to decide on next steps.

items.title: Merck abandons Sutro-partnered IL-2 drug in ‘routine pipeline prioritization’
items.summary: Merck & Co. has called time on a Sutro Biopharma-partnered IL-2 agonist that was being tested for solid tumors.

items.title: Siemens Healthineers rebrands and carves out in vitro diagnostics biz
items.summary: Siemens Healthineers will carve out its in vitro diagnostics business as a standalone company operating under the name Olyrian Diagnostics.

items.title: Rezera revs up for $181M IPO to fund phase 3 trial of NLRP3 inhibitor
items.summary: Rezera—the new name for NodThera—is aiming for a $181 million IPO to take its NLRP3 inhibitor into phase 3 trials for a cardiovascular disease.

items.title: MetaVia sees GLP-1 shed liver fat and body weight in phase 1, takes aim at specific liver disease
items.summary: MetaVia has linked its GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist to reductions in liver fat and body weight in a phase 1 trial. Encouraged by the data, MetaVia plans to start a phase 2 trial in alcohol-associated liver disease next year.

items.title: AstraZeneca said to offer $10B to acquire Rhythm, analysts whisper of a bidding war
items.summary: AstraZeneca has made a roughly $10 billion offer to purchase rare obesity disease player Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, The Wall Street Journal reports. At least three teams of analysts suggest a bidding war could be brewing and that Rhythm is unlikely to settle for AZ’s current pitch.

items.title: Agios aims to shed over 100 R&D roles this year ahead of hoped-for sickle cell disease approval
items.summary: Agios Pharmaceuticals has been shrinking its R&D headcount over the course of 2026 as the commercial-stage company looks to eliminate more than 100 roles by year-end.

items.title: Cash-strapped Vivoryon regains China rights to kidney disease prospect from Simcere
items.summary: Vivoryon Therapeutics has regained the China rights to its kidney disease prospect as the German biotech’s cash reserves begin to dry up.

items.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Alethio attains $90M series A for rare blood cancer drugs
items.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

items.title: Evommune signs $1B deal with China’s Hinova to enter same molecular glue niche as Novartis
items.summary: Evommune has paid $30 million to China’s Hinova Pharmaceuticals to get stuck into a niche of preclinical molecular glue degrader development that’s also being pursued by Novartis.

items.title: T-Therapeutics raises $133M series B for bispecific pipeline with Big Pharma backers in tow
items.summary: T-Therapeutics has pulled in a $133 million series B financing round that will be used to fund the biotech’s lineup of T cell receptor CD3 bispecific drug candidates.

items.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Agios trims 100 R&D roles; Ultragenyx lays off 20%
items.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

items.title: Cloudbreak posts phase 3 eye disease win amid IPO storm
items.summary: A phase 3 study of Cloudbreak Pharma’s eye disease drug candidate has hit its co-primary endpoints, boosting a biotech embroiled in an IPO investigation.

items.title: Agentic AI Is Rewriting The Pharma Marketing Playbook
items.summary: AI is transforming how the pharma industry approaches drug development.

items.title: Asking More of Science: How Daiichi Sankyo Is Challenging Assumptions About the Future of Cancer Care
items.summary: See how Daiichi Sankyo is asking more of science to bring the next wave of innovation to patients.

items.title: Hims & Hers inks deal with Eli Lilly to offer branded weight loss drugs
items.summary: Hims & Hers struck a deal with Eli Lilly to offer the drugmaker’s branded obesity treatments through its online health and wellness platform.

items.title: CMS makes it official, codifying Medicare drug price negotiations established under IRA
items.summary: Against a backdrop of repeated industry challenges in court, the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services is locking in the drug price negotiation framework established under the Biden-era Inflation Reduction Act.

items.title: Actor Jeremy Pope joins ViiV's 'PrEP Wisdom' campaign to educate on long-acting PrEP options
items.summary: ViiV Healthcare has tapped a new mind for its “PrEP Wisdom” campaign, with Tony Award-winning actor and fashion icon Jeremy Pope joining in on the education and awareness messaging around long-acting injectable pre-exposure prophylaxis options.

items.title: Moderna's COVID vaccine carries stellar Q3 revenue beat
items.summary: Moderna posted $1.3 billion in third-quarter revenue, vastly surpassing analyst estimates and avoiding a predicted loss. The Q3 results suggest COVID can still make for a strong business plan.

items.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo sets new Rx record as Wegovy pill rebounds to prior high
items.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: J&J pushes Rybrevant beyond lung cancer with new subQ FDA nod
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: Novartis confirms more reported tumor cases in Zolgensma patients as SMA groups seek details
items.summary: Novartis has confirmed a number of new cases of tumors that developed in children treated with its gene therapy Zolgensma after a series of notices from spinal muscular atrophy advocacy groups this week.

items.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Boehringer’s $7.4B SBP deal; Fresenius’ sweeping biosim pact; A $1B molecular glue bet
items.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim entered a potential $7.4 billion oncology-focused deal with China's SBP Group, as Fresenius formed a 37-asset biosimilar development collaboration with WuXi Biologics, and Evommune licensed an inflammatory disease molecular glue candidate from China's Hinova Pharma.

items.title: Eli Lilly forces compounding rival to shed weight loss claims
items.summary: Eli Lilly has successfully challenged Good Life Meds’ claims about the health benefits and personalization of a compounded tirzepatide product.

items.title: ANI makes $560M play for Egetis and its approved orphan drug Emcitate
items.summary: ANI Pharmaceuticals is handing over $560 million to expand its rare disease business with the proposed buyout of Swedish drugmaker Egetis Therapeutics and its lead asset Emcitate, the first and only approved treatment for MCT8 deficiency.

items.title: RevMed’s Rasonque debut nets ‘eye-popping’ $198M in 5 weeks, even as exec tempers expectations
items.summary: After roughly one month on the market, Revolution Medicines’ RAS inhibitor daraxonrasib is living up to its much-hyped potential, with an initial sales performance that more than one group of analysts considers “eye-popping.”

items.title: Boehringer Ingelheim brings liver health education push to the NASCAR fast lane
items.summary: "Driving Good Health" takes liver disease awareness to three NASCAR races this fall, with the last coming up at the Homestead-Miami Speedway Nov. 6 weekend.

items.title: VintaBio assets go on auction block as CGT viral vector demand slows
items.summary: VintaBio, which debuted in 2023 as a CDMO focused on cranking out viral vectors for cell and gene therapy production, is having its manufacturing facility and intellectual property put up for sale.

items.title: Alnylam seeks new commercial leader as Tolga Tanguler exits amid faltering Amvuttra trajectory
items.summary: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking a new chief commercial officer as the biopharma announced that its six-year CCO veteran, Tolga Tanguler, is leaving the company.

items.title: Vanda drives straight into FDA trouble with fast-paced Nereus ad
items.summary: Vanda Pharmaceuticals’ action-packed TV ad for motion-sickness drug Nereus has irked the FDA, which accused (PDF) the company of creating a misleading impression of the drug’s safety and effectiveness.

items.title: With oncology pipeline at ‘inflection point,’ Merck puts finish line in focus with new corporate campaign
items.summary: In “From Our Pipeline to the Finish Line,” Merck highlights its vision of a cancer-free future and the role it hopes its pipeline will play in achieving that goal.

items.title: Sanofi runs emotive RSV campaign zeroing in on a baby’s bronchiolitis breathing sounds
items.summary: Would you know the difference between a normal cold and one that has turned into something more serious? Sanofi is raising awareness of bronchiolitis, a potential complication of RSV in young children, with a new a tough-to-watch PSA video.

items.title: Samsung Bio union vows strike as labor negotiations stall
items.summary: Samsung Biologics' labor negotiations have stalled out amid mounting tension between union members and management. In response, the union says 400 employees will strike starting November 6.

items.title: Novo catches Wegovy pill tailwind in Q3 as CEO eyes new launch horizons in 2027
items.summary: With a modest improvement to guidance and rosy launch expectations for 2027 girding a solid quarter for its GLP-1 franchise, Novo appears to be gradually winning back the confidence of some of its shareholders.

items.title: Madrigal’s former clinical development head files whistleblower lawsuit alleging Rezdiffra safety cover-up
items.summary: Madrigal Pharmaceuticals is facing a whistleblower lawsuit alleging that senior leadership censored serious liver-injury data related to its breakthrough MASH drug Rezdiffra and retaliated against the firm’s top clinical development head who tried to sound the alarm.
